source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per battle, as this unit is chosen to shoot, its models' ranged weapons gain **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)** for the rest of that phase. A token beside the unit can track that it has been used.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
